catalog.title: Adapters
catalog.helpDescription: Search by name or description; type and status filters can be combined.
catalog.name: Adapter name
catalog.taskHelp: Run manually or automatically on a schedule.
catalog.webhookHelp: Run when another system sends a request, such as an alert or notification.
catalog.createNote: Continue editing and saving after creation. Nothing runs automatically.

settings.title: Adapter settings
settings.summary: Edit the name and description. The language cannot change after creation.
settings.accessSummary: Current access: {{level}}. Sharing permissions can be viewed and managed here.
settings.name: Name
settings.unsavedClose: Settings have unsaved changes. Close and discard them?
settings.readOnlyAccess: This share is read-only. You can view code, dependencies, configuration, logs and history, but cannot edit, save, run, use AI, change permissions or delete the adapter.
settings.editAccess: This is an editable share: editing, saving, running and trigger configuration are allowed, but deleting the Adapter and managing sharing permissions are unavailable.
settings.archivedDescription: This Adapter has been removed from the active list.
settings.deleteDescription: Deletes code and saved versions, execution history and logs, inputs and outputs, triggers, sharing and credential bindings.
settings.deleteWarningActive: Reception stops and the worker is asked to cancel. Deletion waits for confirmed termination; an offline worker or cancellation timeout blocks deletion.
settings.deleteWarningIdle: Stored credentials remain. The worker cleans the dedicated runtime environment; cleanup may be delayed while it is offline.
settings.deleteReasonLocked: Stop the Adapter before deleting it
settings.deleteWarningWebhook: An Adapter cannot be deleted while it is receiving or has active calls.
settings.deleteWarningTask: An Adapter cannot be deleted while its schedule or execution is active.
settings.dangerHint: Removes this adapter, its history and sharing. Stored system credentials remain.
settings.nameTooLong: Use at most 128 characters. Your input is preserved; shorten it before saving.
settings.deleteRecords: Executions, logs, input records and output results
settings.deleteConfig: Schedule and request triggers, sharing and credential bindings
settings.deleteKeepHint: Only this adapter’s bindings are removed, not the passwords or keys.
settings.deleteIrreversible: This cannot be restored from the interface. Review the following before deleting.

sharing.title: Permissions and sharing
sharing.loadFailed: Sharing permissions could not be loaded
sharing.saveFailed: Sharing permissions could not be saved
sharing.revokeFailed: Sharing permission could not be removed
sharing.credentialWarning: Editors can use bound credentials through a task. Passwords and keys are hidden; grant access only to trusted users.
sharing.managementHelp: Administrator accounts and administrator tokens have full management access.
sharing.readScope: View code, settings, logs and execution history; cannot edit or run.
sharing.editScope: Edit code and run settings, save versions and run tasks.
sharing.scopeLimit: Shared access does not allow deleting adapters, managing sharing or changing credential bindings.

clone.title: Clone Adapter
clone.description: The current code, dependencies, runtime configuration (including the per-execution timeout), Credential references and Runtime Worker will be copied.
clone.historyNote: Execution history is not copied; the new Adapter remains stopped and will not run automatically.
clone.inputNote: Input configuration is copied, but input files are not. Upload and save them again in the new adapter.
clone.name: New Adapter name

save.title: Save Adapter
save.firstSaveHint: The first save requires a Runtime Worker. View or change it later in Runtime settings.
save.workerAria: Runtime Worker for saving the Adapter
save.workerPlaceholder: Select a Worker that supports the current language (reliable offline queueing requires RabbitMQ execution)
save.noWorker: No Worker supports this language. Register a compatible Worker first.

batch.limit: Select at most {{count}} adapters. Narrow the filters or select fewer items.
batch.readOnly: View only; batch actions are unavailable
batch.refreshFirst: Refresh the list before trying again
batch.configureFirst: Save the event source configuration first
batch.title: Batch actions
batch.savedOnly: Only saved code and run settings are used. Unsaved changes will not be submitted.
batch.stopBoundary: Disabling schedules or receiving keeps existing executions and received data in progress. Cancellation does not undo external writes already made.
batch.unknownHelp: The connection was interrupted or results cannot be read. Check this operation again; it will not be resubmitted before its results are known.
batch.missingRestore: Restore the original preparation with the same operation ID. This does not run any start or stop actions.
batch.missingNew: Close this panel, select adapters again, and explicitly create a new operation.
batch.summary: {{total}} total · {{completed}} accepted or completed · {{pending}} pending · {{stopping}} stopping · {{failed}} failed · {{unknown}} need confirmation
batch.failureFallback: This action is unavailable. Check the adapter settings before trying again.

action.cancel_executions: Cancel the unfinished executions selected for this operation
action.enable_schedule: Enable the saved schedule without an extra immediate run
action.disable_subscription: Stop new events and wait for the listener to close

errors.execution_input_too_large: The saved input exceeds the size limit for one execution.
errors.schedule_invalid_cron: The saved schedule rule is invalid. Check the run settings.
errors.schedule_invalid_timezone: The saved time zone is invalid. Check the run settings.
errors.webhook_path_in_use: This Webhook address is already used by another adapter.
errors.webhook_credential_type_invalid: Webhook requires a Token credential. Check the run settings.
